items.t: Keel Infrastructure (KEEL) Leaves Bitcoin Behind As AI Data Center Permits Move Ahead
items.sum: Keel Infrastructure (NasdaqGM:KEEL) has fully exited its Bitcoin holdings and ended its Bitcoin treasury exposure. The business plans ongoing daily Bitcoin sales as it winds down mining activities and reallocates resources to other uses. items.t: Keel Infrastructure (KEEL) Could Be 73% Undervalued After Third Quarter Results
items.sum: Keel Infrastructure (KEEL) has released third quarter results reporting US$27.6 million in sales and a wider net loss of US$62.71 million. The update has refocused attention on its ongoing business transition. The share price reaction has been severe, with Keel Infrastructure down 21.43% on a 1 day share price return and 50.45% over 30 days, while the 1 year total shareholder return has fallen 54.
